name: AegisChain Integrity Charter
principles: Neutrality — system enforces integrity, not ideology
Transparency — all anchors, ledgers, and policies are public and auditable
Non-bypassability — all AI calls and external fetches are mediated
Immutable Anchors — preambles, charters and policies are cryptographically locked
Fork Visibility — any fork lacking valid signatures is recognisable
Diversity — adjudication and anchoring cannot be controlled by a single provider
Self-hardening — code verifies its own integrity and refuses to run if altered
Independent Verification — anyone can check proofs with the public CLI/API
notes: Update the hash field after computing the SHA-256 of the file contents.
